metadata.title: Chicken with Potatoes | Awushi Kulho | Naga Recipe
metadata.description:
Awushi Kulho or Chicken & potato pottage, is a delicious yet simple Naga recipe that's free of oil or any excess masala or spices. This is easy to prepare, takes very less time and is a very good accompaniment with meals. 

To make this dish chicken pieces are boiled in water till they're half done and then rest of the ingredients are added to the boil. The whole mixture is cooked till the chicken are well done and potatoes cooked. Mash few potatoes to thicken the gravy.

Ingredients:

1 kg of Chicken
4 medium sized potatoes
7 fresh green chilies
1 Tbs ginger
Salt to taste
